title: Multimodal Emotion Recognition
summary: Bachelor's thesis comparing six models across text, audio, and image modalities with three fusion strategies and built-in explainability.
problem: Emotion recognition models trained on a single modality (text, audio, or image alone) miss cues that only surface when the signals are considered together.
approach: Trained and compared six models across text, audio, and image inputs, evaluated three fusion strategies for combining them, and applied Integrated Gradients and Grad-CAM to explain each prediction.
outcome: A feature-caching layer that reused precomputed embeddings cut experiment turnaround from hours to minutes, making it practical to run far more fusion-strategy comparisons within the thesis timeline.

title: The Paternalistic Filter
summary: An audit of four LLMs acting as history tutors, testing roughly 1,800 responses about the 1989 Romanian Revolution for differential treatment across student personas.
problem: Safety-aligned LLMs used as tutors can treat students differently based on perceived identity, but whether marginalized students receive systematically worse educational support was unverified.
approach: Ran an API audit of four LLMs role-playing as history tutors, generating roughly 1,800 responses to personas varying by ethnicity and socioeconomic status, then coded each response for refusal rate, explanatory depth, and framing language.
outcome: Identified four patterns of what the paper terms 'epistemic paternalism,' including safety models refusing about three-quarters of educational requests from lower-income personas.

title: TaskFlow
summary: A team productivity and task-management web app built with ASP.NET Core MVC.

title: Library Management Database
summary: A relational database for a library system, built in Oracle PL/SQL: books, authors, publishers, loans, and reservations, with stored procedures for activity reports and triggers that archive loan history.

title: Falloc
summary: A two-person Best-Fit memory allocator using mmap for direct memory management, mutexes for thread safety, and memory protection to guard allocated regions, minimizing internal and external fragmentation for multithreaded workloads.

title: BacPeBune
summary: A team-built exam-prep platform for Romanian high schoolers studying for the Bacalaureat in Math and Computer Science, with real-time chat and an interactive mind-mapping tool.
